name: decision-note
prompt: Write a note: we decided to move the search index to PostgreSQL, because the current store cannot do full-text search. Alice migrates the schema next week.
expected_output: notes/<today>-<slug>.md, opening with a frontmatter holding status: draft, and closing with a ## Next section naming Alice's schema migration.
assertions: The note is a file under notes/ named 2026-10-07-<slug>.md, 2026-10-07 being the day of the run, its slug three words at most from the note's subject, lowercase and joined by hyphens
The note opens with a frontmatter holding status: draft
The note closes with a ## Next section
